E3208

Could not generate bindings from `{header}`.

What

Could not generate bindings from `{header}`.

Why

{reason}

Fix

Fix the header path, install dev headers, run `jet inspect bind` manually for details, or hand-write `#Extern module c.{lib}`.

Error [E3208]: could not generate bindings from `missing.h`.
 Why: the header file could not be read (No such file or directory (os error 2)).
 Fix: fix the header path, install dev headers, run `jet inspect bind` manually for details, or hand-write `#Extern module c.missing`.
